message: Assigned existing P2 intermittent MCP receive/dispatch stalls task. Start with canonical task spec and current production/3.63 sources; build deterministic bounded SignalR integration reproducer and privacy-safe correlated stage timings (MCP accepted -> SignalR dispatch -> client handler -> actual command -> reply -> server response) to distinguish network, callback head-of-line blocking and Git contention. Earlier observations: 217/3870 requests >30s, 59 >60s, clustered completions and no Nginx 499/502/504, with local GetJobResult work ~0ms despite ~9s server request. The main source is clean and separate worktree is required. Keep diagnosis grounded, measure p50/p95/p99 before selecting fix; preserve request correlation, cancellation, retries and idempotency. Coordinate with Worker 3's unintegrated P1 SQLite execution gate (overlaps Server/McpTools.fs, ClientService.fs, Client/SignalR/Client.fs) and Worker 1's accepted-but-unmerged Task.WhenAny auto-promotion (protocol 3.64): use isolated tests/telemetry first and avoid rewriting their in-flight changes or assuming a deployed feature. No merge/deploy without approval; submit frozen independent review only once implementation and full Release tests are ready. Yield at end.
